name: Kurokawa Fuyuno
source:
Class: 1-C

One of the girls from the school's infamous gyaru duo. While she has a cool appearance and is physically very strong, Fuyuno is in fact an idiot who gets bad grades at school. She often has guys attempting to hit on her and scouts trying to get her to join their agencies, but she turns all of them down.

Fuyuno has somewhat of a romantic side to her, as she believes that one day a prince riding a white horse will come pick her up. She also has a huge appetite.

She is childhood friends with her partner-in-crime [url=/c130986]Kaon[/url]. She is also friends with [url=/c130984]Kukuri[/url] who taught Fuyuno on how to do roundhouse kicks.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245143]Getchu[/url]]
